philosophy: Right horse for right course — correct-size model + tight remit, not biggest model.

sync.direction: repo SSOT → ~/.cursor/ on seat boot; local edits back to repo same session (self-compound)

model_tiers.frontier: Planning, judgment, solo-vs-team routing, constitutional trade-offs — ≤1 invocation per job
model_tiers.standard: Orchestration with bounded remit; explicit model always
model_tiers.worker: Composer / generation / extraction — tight scope, no routing authority

vellum_routing_sidecar.description: Light WHO decision on Vellum task metadata — not full PRM bureaucracy

fields.worker_tiers: array of explicit worker tier labels when mode != solo
fields.solo_or_delegate_reason: one line — why solo vs delegate
fields.witnessed_before_spawn: boolean — must be true before Task/subagent/API team spawn
fields.cursor_thread_owner: cursor — Cursor-originated work stays on Cursor audit trail

ide_sovereignty.principle: Each IDE owns its thread end-to-end; shared SSOT holds per-IDE slices only
ide_sovereignty.cross_seat_handoff: explicit baton + Vellum consent — never silent offload
ide_sovereignty.external_routes: Beast API / Vellum / other seats allowed within estate boundaries; no laundering outside IDE audit trail

cursor.thread_ownership: Cursor parent accountable for all subagent spawns in Cursor session
cursor.sub_cursor: Still Cursor responsibility end-to-end — not subcontracted

subagent_rules.delegate_when: independent remit AND parent would load heavy context (>2 unread files, >100 log lines, external URL corpus)

api_team.audit_trail: Cursor thread + Vellum plan/actual — no silent externalization

claude_code.thread_ownership: Claude Code session owns Claude subagents end-to-end
claude_code.note: Cursor slice not loaded in Claude — sovereignty boundary

antigravity.thread_ownership: Antigravity session owns its agents end-to-end
antigravity.note: Cursor slice not loaded in Antigravity — sovereignty boundary
